title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：patent　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 patent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the clerk ① held the patent that no applicant in the office would have measured, and he said the holding was the whole of the month. The ② patent, meaning the right itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a patent, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ patent in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ patent at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A patent, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the clerk said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the patent was the whole of the matter, meaning the reward and not the right. The ⑥ patent, meaning the reward and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; patent, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a right and a reward. He said the reward is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ patent had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ patent of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of measuring; patent, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ patent I remember is the right measured in the file, which closed in 1983 and is still measured as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ patent, my mother said in 1985, is the only right that improves by being measured; every patent, she said, is a reward that has agreed to look like a right. She said the reward was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 专利（指办事处里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 专利（指那项专利本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the patent 持有这一项专利
D. n. 专利（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 专利之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的专利之事）
F. n. 专利（指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一项）
G. n. 专利、回报（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 回报（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the patent that no applicant in the office would have measured
The patent, meaning the right itself and not the stamp
the patent at the far counter
the patent was the whole of the matter
the patent had become a line in a file
The patent of the whole thing
A patent, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: hold the patent 意为“持有这一项专利”，1976 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯测量的一项专利做了一遍。
patent 意为“专利”，指那项专利本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
patent 意为“专利”，指办事处里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
patent 意为“专利”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
patent 意为“专利、回报”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项回报就是那件事的全部。
patent 意为“回报”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项专利，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
patent 意为“专利”，指卷宗里写到、被测量的那一项，到 1981 年这一项成了卷宗里的一行。
patent 意为“专利之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的专利之事是一处办事处和三个月份的测量。
patent 意为“专利”，我记得的是卷宗里测量过的那一项，1983 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一项。
patent 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，专利是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的专利。
